<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The simple pull quote (model pull-quote@1): the words in a blockquote, then the author (names the section), a
  role line and the source as a link, in a figure. Axes: layout (rule: a bar in the primary token at the start,
  centered: centred, no bar).
-->
<script lang="ts">
export type PullQuoteSimpleProps = {
  id: string;
  quote: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  sourceLabel?: string;
  sourceHref?: string;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  layout?: "rule" | "centered";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import LinkPlain from "../compose/LinkPlain.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  quote,
  title,
  description = "",
  sourceLabel = "",
  sourceHref = "",
  padding = "standard",
  layout = "rule",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<PullQuoteSimpleProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const frame = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "rule" ? "flex flex-row gap-6"
  : "flex flex-col items-center"
);
const copyAlign = computed(() => ((layout as string) === "rule") ? "start" : "center");
const copyText = computed(() => ((layout as string) === "rule") ? "text-start" : "text-center");
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="
      (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
      : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
      : 'py-16 lg:py-32'
    "
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="pull-quote-simple"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
      <Box tag="figure" :class="cn('mx-auto max-w-3xl', frame)">
        <Box
          v-if="((layout as string) === 'rule')"
          class="w-2 shrink-0 self-stretch rounded-full bg-primary"
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
        <Stack gap="6" :align="copyAlign">
          <Text tag="blockquote" size="2xl" weight="medium" :class="cn('tracking-tight', copyText)">
            {{ quote }}
          </Text>
          <Stack gap="2" :align="copyAlign">
            <Text size="base" weight="semibold" :class="copyText" :id="titleId">
              {{ title }}
            </Text>
            <Text v-if="description" size="sm" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', copyText)">
              {{ description }}
            </Text>
            <LinkPlain
              v-if="(sourceLabel && sourceHref)"
              :href="urlOf(sourceHref)"
              class="text-primary hover:text-foreground"
            >
              <Text size="sm">
                {{ sourceLabel }}
              </Text>
            </LinkPlain>
          </Stack>
        </Stack>
      </Box>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
